steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Note-taking: write DURING the performance — focus on specific moments, not general impressions. | Key Fact: Four areas to analyse: performance (acting), design (set, costume, lighting, sound), direction (staging, pacing), and overall intention. | Key Fact: Always identify WHAT you saw, HOW it was done, and WHAT EFFECT it had on the audience. | Key Fact: Use precise terminology: 'proscenium arch' not 'normal stage'; 'gobo' not 'light pattern'; 'blocking' not 'where they stood'.

steps.title: Lesson 3: Application
steps.body: What should you focus on when taking notes during a live theatre performance? | Explain the difference between DESCRIBING a moment and ANALYSING it. Why does analysis score higher marks? | How would you structure your analysis of a key moment from a production you have seen?
